```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()
metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
# Six chromatic colors from base R's colorblind-safe Okabe-Ito palette
okabe_ito <- unname(palette.colors(7, palette = "Okabe-Ito")[-1])

crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(cat_mcap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(date, category_name, fill = list(cat_mcap = 0)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(share = cat_mcap / sum(cat_mcap)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Order legend (and stacked bands) from largest to smallest typical share
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, share, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  # Mark the Luna/UST crash (May 7–12, 2022) and FTX collapse (Nov 8–11, 2022)
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = ymd(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
    xmax = ymd(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11")),
    ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
    fill = "black", alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = ymd(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = ymd("2022-04-20"), y = 0.88, hjust = 1, size = 3,
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, label.size = 0.25,
    label = "Luna/UST crash\n(May 7–12, 2022)"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = ymd("2022-11-28"), y = 0.78, hjust = 0, size = 3,
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, label.size = 0.25,
    label = "FTX collapse\n(Nov 8–11, 2022)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = okabe_ito) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y", expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market-Cap Share by Category, 2018–2026",
    subtitle = "Daily share of total market capitalization across six coin categories (summing to 100%)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: Course cryptocurrency dataset (22 coins, Jan 2018–May 2026)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot"
  )
```
